title: Fuzz run record
description: A machine-checkable record of one fuzz run (V2-17): the oracle, the seed corpus manifest, the budget, the fixed seed, and every failing input with its captured output. It makes a run replayable (same corpus and seed give the same executions_digest) and reviewable (each finding names the rule it violates). It does not prove the target is free of bugs: a random mutator without coverage guidance explores a tiny fraction of the input space, and a clean run only means this oracle saw nothing in this budget.

tool.description: Adapter that produced the record, e.g. 'fuzz_run.py'.

version.description: Adapter version; the record means little without it.

target.description: Command template that was executed, with @INPUT@ for the input path.

cwd.description: Working directory the target ran in.

commit.description: Commit under test, or null when the run was not inside a git work tree.

seed.description: Fixed RNG seed. With the same corpus it must reproduce executions_digest.

oracle.description: Rules that decide a finding: exit:N, exit-not-in:N,M, stdout-contains:TEXT, stderr-contains:TEXT, timeout. A run is a finding when any rule matches.

manifest.description: Every seed file with its SHA-256, in sorted path order. Reading a different corpus changes the digest.

runs.description: Requested mutated executions after the seed files.

stopped_early.description: True when max_findings stopped the run before the budget was spent.

executions_digest.description: SHA-256 over the ordered input hashes. Same corpus and seed must reproduce it; a mismatch means the run is not the one recorded.

seed_input.description: Corpus path this input was mutated from, or null for an unmutated seed.

verdict.description: clean: no oracle matched within the budget. findings: at least one input is recorded.
